q1_what_did_you_play: I played Bang Bang! on Seapunk, then Kaboom! on Seapunk, then Kaboom! on Seapunk, then Duck and Cover. This used all 3 Energy and all 2 Sparks, dealt 24 total damage to Seapunk, and gained 5 Block before the telegraphed 11-damage attack.
q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered Fwoosh! + Kaboom! + Kaboom! + Duck and Cover. That line would deal 22 damage, gain 5 Block, use all 3 Energy, and leave 1 Spark unspent. It was close because it preserves a Spark at the cost of only 2 damage this turn.
q3_what_it_gave_up: The chosen line gave up the 1 Spark that the Fwoosh! line would have saved. It also used Bang Bang! instead of Fwoosh!, trading a single 8-damage hit for two 5-damage hits, which is better immediately against the single enemy but empties the Spark bank.
q4_different_intent: No. A different enemy intent would not have changed the line under the information given. If the attack were larger, the 5 Block from Duck and Cover would be even more valuable. If the intent were smaller or non-attack, Duck and Cover is still the only remaining energy card and does not reduce the maximum damage available this turn.
